_: Kolecto edition of the AI-augmented PDLC hackathon. Three squads (A → B → C contract chain), gates on demand, one scripted business change.
title: Smart payment reminders

hats.Specification Engineer: Turns the need into a spec the AI can follow: holds the pen on intent, spec and contract.
hats.Context Engineer: Keeps what the AI reads correct and current: reads the other squad's contract, keeps pins up to date.
hats.Agentic Workflow Orchestrator: Makes the AI work step by step: drives Claude Code through plan, tasks, code and deploy.
hats.Decision Guarantor: Guarantees no decision ships without a named human: signs, and flips the flag.
hats.Evaluation Engineer: Checks that what the AI produced is right: reviews tests, adds edge cases (third person in a squad).

squad-a-policy.label: Policy
squad-a-policy.slice: Decide whether an invoice gets a reminder today, at which step, with which fees
squad-a-policy.specifySeed: decideReminder decides, for one invoice and one day, whether a payment reminder is due, at which step (friendly, firm, formal) and with which late-payment fees, following the programme business rules.
squad-a-policy.demoPrompt: Write a TypeScript function that decides whether an unpaid invoice should get a payment reminder today, and returns the reminder level and the late fees.
squad-a-policy.demoWatch: Without context the agent invents thresholds (7/14/30 days?), fee rules, field names and floats for money. With context it cites RR-01..05, uses minor units and the reference cases.

squad-b-outreach.label: Outreach
squad-b-outreach.slice: Plan the reminder: when to send it, which template and subject, what amount due, which event
squad-b-outreach.specifySeed: planReminder turns a reminder decision published by squad A into a planned e-mail: send time inside the business sending window, template and subject in the customer's language, fee lines, amount due, and the reminder_scheduled event.
squad-b-outreach.demoPrompt: Write a TypeScript function that schedules a payment reminder e-mail for an overdue invoice and builds its subject line.
squad-b-outreach.demoWatch: Without context the agent picks its own sending hours, ignores public holidays and time zones, and invents the decision's fields. With context it follows RR-06..09 and the reminder-decision contract.

squad-c-insight.label: Insight
squad-c-insight.slice: Measure the pilot: which invoices were reminded, how many were paid within 7 days, the payment delay, the fees scheduled
squad-c-insight.specifySeed: measurePilot turns squad B's planned reminders and the payments into the pilot's figures for a period: reminded invoices by step, share paid within 7 days, average payment delay, fees scheduled, following the programme business rules.
squad-c-insight.demoPrompt: Write a TypeScript function that computes, for a period, how many unpaid invoices got a payment reminder and what share of them were paid within a week.
squad-c-insight.demoWatch: Without context the agent counts every reminder instead of every invoice, picks its own window and rounding, and invents the plan's fields. With context it follows RR-10..13, reuses Core Billing's paidWithinRate and averagePaymentDelay, and the reminder-events contract.
